entries.title: Complete the AstroCrown homepage and Genesis Programme experience
entries.problem: The primary website and Genesis Programme need to become complete, coherent, trustworthy and usable launch entry points.
entries.user_benefit: Visitors can understand AstroCrown, use the available services, assess the Genesis Programme accurately and complete only those account or wallet actions that are actually enabled.
entries.distinctive_value: A unified AstroCrown experience with a distinctive deep-space identity, transparent evidence boundaries and a clear Genesis Member identity.
entries.repeat_use: Market and discovery services should give visitors a reason to return; Genesis status and community participation should remain meaningful after first registration.
entries.distribution_mechanism: Search-discoverable public pages, shareable content, public Genesis recognition where approved, and accessible service entry points.

evidence.reference: Owner direction, 2026-11-20: finish the website and Genesis Programme page promptly and to a high standard.

risks: Do not present illustrative market data as live or verified.
Do not enable Genesis qualifying payments or ACROWN purchases before all owner, technical, treasury, legal and operational gates pass.
Do not imply planned privileges or future services are already available.
acceptance_criteria: Homepage and Genesis Programme page have consistent, polished, accessible, responsive experiences.
All figures, wallet actions, payments, listings and service states accurately reflect verified operational status.
Core account, wallet and Genesis journeys pass applicable browser, security and regression tests.
entries.notes: Approved priority and outcome; exact detailed scope remains governed by existing section and Genesis requirements.

entries.title: Market Intelligence
entries.problem: Users need a coherent way to understand market conditions and compare assets without navigating disconnected data sources.
entries.user_benefit: A reliable market overview, asset directory, sector comparisons, movers and documented market context.
entries.distinctive_value: Transparent data provenance, comparable market context and clearly separated observations from interpretation.
entries.repeat_use: Fresh market conditions, asset discovery and comparisons can create recurring utility.
entries.distribution_mechanism: Public asset and sector pages with source attribution and shareable links.
risks: Market-data licensing and redistribution restrictions.
Provider cost, rate limits, freshness and inconsistent asset identity.
Risk of displaying synthetic or stale values as live data.
acceptance_criteria: Every displayed market metric has a defined source, timestamp, methodology and unavailable-data behavior.
Data-provider contracts and redistribution rights are qualified before integration.
Historical and current values are distinguishable.
entries.notes: The current homepage contains illustrative market content; the existence of the interface does not mean live data is connected.

entries.title: Research and Discovery
entries.problem: Market participants need to investigate assets, protocols, events and ecosystems beyond a price chart.
entries.user_benefit: Source-linked project research, tokenomics examination, historical context and comparative analysis.
entries.distinctive_value: Research that connects raw observations, source evidence, methodology, competing explanations and uncertainty.
entries.repeat_use: Users can return to investigate new events, compare projects and follow evolving research.
entries.distribution_mechanism: Public research dossiers, citations, data visualisations and author-attributed pages.
risks: Research claims can become outdated or overstate what sources establish.
Entity resolution and source independence may be incomplete.
Research quality needs explicit review and correction processes.
acceptance_criteria: Important claims link to dated primary or otherwise authoritative evidence.
Conflicts, unknowns and rejected hypotheses remain visible.
A published research item has a reproducible method and correction history.
entries.notes: Candidate service; scope and first research vertical remain to be validated.

entries.title: Personal Intelligence Workspace
entries.problem: Users lack a persistent place to organise market interests, research and monitoring preferences across AstroCrown services.
entries.user_benefit: Watchlists, saved research, alerts, comparisons and personalised dashboards.
entries.distinctive_value: A unified workspace whose privacy controls and provenance are consistent across the platform.
entries.repeat_use: Personal watchlists, saved work and relevant alerts create recurring use.
entries.distribution_mechanism: User-controlled public sharing of selected watchlists or dashboards; private data remains private by default.
risks: Private holdings, wallet addresses and personal research must not leak through public sharing.
Alerts need reliable freshness and abuse controls.
Account and recovery boundaries must remain explicit.
acceptance_criteria: Private data is never published without explicit user action and visible scope.
Saved objects have stable ownership and access controls.
Notifications distinguish verified events from inferred signals.
entries.notes: Candidate; the exact account/session implementation must follow the canonical account requirements.

entries.title: Blockchain Intelligence
entries.problem: Users need to understand on-chain activity and network relationships rather than relying only on market-price movements.
entries.user_benefit: Read-only wallet, transfer, contract, protocol and network activity research with explorer-linked evidence.
entries.distinctive_value: Cross-chain observation with explicit identity confidence, provenance, limitations and separation of ownership claims from address activity.
entries.repeat_use: Monitoring selected networks, addresses, contracts and protocol events.
entries.distribution_mechanism: Shareable read-only investigation reports and network visualisations.
risks: Address attribution false positives.
Chain data coverage and provider licensing.
Sensitive wallet/portfolio privacy.
Read-only analytics must not accidentally expose transaction execution.
acceptance_criteria: Every transaction observation links to the canonical explorer and chain.
Attribution confidence and alternative explanations are disclosed.
No signing, custody or transaction execution is implied by read-only monitoring.
entries.notes: Candidate service; initial network coverage and providers require qualification.

entries.title: AstroCrown First-Party Community and Knowledge Network
entries.problem: AstroCrown needs its own authoritative place for members to publish, discuss, collaborate and participate in specialist communities and governance.
entries.user_benefit: First-party profiles, posts, specialist groups, discussions, contribution histories and transparent community processes.
entries.distinctive_value: A community and knowledge network integrated with AstroCrown identity, services and governance rather than relying on third-party platforms as the official community.
entries.repeat_use: Ongoing discussions, research collaboration, group activity and member participation.
entries.distribution_mechanism: Public posts, public profiles and shareable discussions where user privacy and moderation rules permit.

evidence.reference: Owner product direction recorded 2026-11-19: AstroCrown must build its own official social, community and governance platform.
GitHub PR #194 (draft Community Network foundation; not merged into main as of 2026-11-20).

risks: Moderation, appeals, privacy and abuse handling require complete policy.
Council elections require approved constitutional rules.
The current Community PR is a draft development slice, not production readiness.
acceptance_criteria: AstroCrown remains the authoritative community platform.
External social networks are optional sharing surfaces only.
Identity, moderation, privacy and governance rules are explicit before public activation.
entries.notes: Product direction approved; current implementation and remaining requirements are tracked separately in the Community PR and its audit record.

entries.title: Developer and Integration Infrastructure
entries.problem: External developers, researchers and AI systems may want to consume AstroCrown data and capabilities without using the website UI.
entries.user_benefit: Documented APIs, data exports, embeddable components, SDKs and machine-readable interfaces.
entries.distinctive_value: Provider-neutral, provenance-preserving interfaces built around AstroCrown's own verified intelligence and methodologies.
entries.repeat_use: External integrations can make AstroCrown useful inside other products and workflows.
entries.distribution_mechanism: Developer integrations, embedded widgets and machine-readable research endpoints.
risks: API abuse and quota exhaustion.
Licensing and redistribution rights.
Data provenance and schema versioning.
MCP/API responses must not overstate confidence or bypass privacy controls.
acceptance_criteria: Stable versioned contracts with documented authentication, quotas and provenance.
Provider and model adapters remain replaceable.
Read-only and write-capable scopes are separated.
entries.notes: Candidate; implement only after a stable internal service contract exists.

entries.title: Why Is This Moving? Evidence-Linked Market Investigation
entries.problem: A price move alone does not explain the underlying observable developments or the evidence supporting possible explanations.
entries.user_benefit: An investigation that links market changes to on-chain observations, liquidity, protocol events, governance, news and competing explanations.
entries.distinctive_value: A user-facing chain from observation to hypothesis, evidence, contradiction, uncertainty and update history.
entries.repeat_use: Users can open investigations when meaningful market events occur and follow subsequent evidence.
entries.distribution_mechanism: Interactive evidence maps and shareable investigation dossiers.
risks: Correlation is not causation.
Incomplete data and source dependencies can create false explanations.
AI-generated narratives must be independently checked.
acceptance_criteria: Observed facts, correlations, causal hypotheses and unknowns are visually distinct.
Each claim links to evidence and observation time.
Competing hypotheses and evidence against the leading explanation are included.
entries.notes: Candidate signature feature; should evolve the existing Influence Map only after data contracts and methodologies are qualified.

entries.title: Transparent AstroCrown Market Intelligence Indices
entries.problem: Generic sentiment or influence scores are difficult to evaluate when their inputs, methodology and historical revisions are hidden.
entries.user_benefit: Reproducible indices with source definitions, weights, methodology versions, data coverage and historical snapshots.
entries.distinctive_value: An inspectable methodology that can be independently reconstructed and evaluated.
entries.repeat_use: Historical context and updated market conditions provide recurring utility.
entries.distribution_mechanism: Public index pages, datasets, methodology documents and shareable snapshots.
risks: Indicator selection or weights may be arbitrary.
Historical data may be revised or incomplete.
Users may mistake descriptive indicators for forecasts.
acceptance_criteria: Every calculation is versioned and reproducible.
Input sources, coverage and transformations are documented.
No prediction or investment-return guarantee is implied.
entries.notes: Candidate extension of Fear & Greed Consensus and Influence Map concepts; methodology not yet selected.

entries.title: Public Shareable Research and Dashboards
entries.problem: Useful user-created research is often trapped in private workspaces and cannot easily introduce others to its underlying service.
entries.user_benefit: Read-only public research pages and dashboards with clear author, date, sources and methodology.
entries.distinctive_value: User-created work becomes a durable, attributable and verifiable AstroCrown resource.
entries.repeat_use: Authors can update research; readers can follow topics and create their own investigations.
entries.distribution_mechanism: Unique URLs, social previews, embeds and public discovery pages.
risks: Private wallet or portfolio data exposure.
Public content abuse and unmoderated financial claims.
Search indexing stale or misleading research.
acceptance_criteria: Publishing is explicit and scoped; private is the default.
Public content contains provenance, timestamps and revision state.
Shared pages are useful without forcing account creation before value is visible.
entries.notes: Candidate growth mechanism; privacy and moderation requirements are mandatory.

entries.title: Embeddable AstroCrown Intelligence Widgets
entries.problem: AstroCrown intelligence cannot reach audiences who primarily consume information on other websites.
entries.user_benefit: Third-party publishers can embed selected AstroCrown market summaries, signals and visualisations with source attribution.
entries.distinctive_value: AstroCrown-branded intelligence that sends interested readers back to the underlying research.
entries.repeat_use: External publishers can display updated information on their own pages.
entries.distribution_mechanism: Embeddable web components or iframe widgets with clear attribution and link-back.
risks: Embedding provider licensing and attribution terms.
Cross-origin security, privacy and performance.
Data costs can scale with external views.
acceptance_criteria: Widgets expose only data that AstroCrown is authorized to redistribute.
Attribution, timestamp and link-back are built in.
Caching and quotas protect provider and infrastructure limits.
entries.notes: The embed format is established elsewhere; differentiation must come from AstroCrown-owned intelligence, not the existence of an iframe.

entries.title: AstroCrown Living Market Laboratory
entries.problem: Users cannot easily explore a continuously updated, connected model of digital-asset events, investigate causal hypotheses, test counterfactuals and see how conclusions change as evidence arrives.
entries.user_benefit: A continuously updated research environment linking assets, networks, protocols, events and evidence with agent-assisted investigation and scenario exploration.
entries.distinctive_value: Potential integration of a persistent ecosystem model, autonomous evidence-seeking investigation, counterfactual simulation, continuous re-evaluation and a public versioned archive.
entries.repeat_use: Users can follow investigations, test scenarios and revisit updated conclusions as new evidence becomes available.
entries.distribution_mechanism: Public investigation timelines, evidence graphs, scenario comparisons and reproducible research dossiers.
risks: Several component capabilities already exist in competing products.
A true digital twin of the entire market is infeasible without explicit scope and data coverage.
Simulation outputs can be mistaken for predictions.
Agentic research may produce unsupported conclusions or source loops.
acceptance_criteria: Define a narrow, measurable initial ecosystem perimeter.
Preserve source snapshots, temporal cutoffs and provenance.
Separate observations, hypotheses, simulations and realized outcomes.
Use independent verification and explicit counter-evidence.
Benchmark against current competitor capabilities before public differentiation claims.
entries.notes: High-potential flagship candidate, not an approved implementation requirement and not proven globally unique.

entries.title: AstroCrown Market Time Machine
entries.problem: Retrospective analysis can suffer from hindsight bias and data leakage when current conclusions use information unavailable at the historical date.
entries.user_benefit: Reconstruct what evidence was available at a chosen historical cutoff and compare the historical analysis with subsequent outcomes.
entries.distinctive_value: Time-bounded, provenance-preserving reconstruction that distinguishes what was knowable then from what became known later.
entries.repeat_use: Historical event analysis, model evaluation and research audit.
entries.distribution_mechanism: Shareable time-capsule investigations and reproducible historical reports.
risks: Historical feeds may not preserve their original versions.
Timestamp granularity and publication-time accuracy may be insufficient.
Survivorship and look-ahead bias can invalidate conclusions.
acceptance_criteria: Historical cutoff is enforced across all evidence retrieval.
Original source timestamps and snapshot versions are preserved.
Unavailable historical evidence is explicitly marked rather than reconstructed by guesswork.
entries.notes: Candidate extension of the Living Market Laboratory; requires historical-data feasibility research.

entries.title: Built-In Product Distribution and Adoption Mechanisms
entries.problem: A product that is useful but difficult to discover, share or revisit may fail to achieve meaningful adoption.
entries.user_benefit: Users can share useful work, discover public research, follow relevant activity and return to services that evolve over time.
entries.distinctive_value: Distribution is designed into services and data architecture rather than treated only as post-launch marketing.
entries.repeat_use: Each service must establish a genuine recurring-use reason appropriate to its purpose.
entries.distribution_mechanism: Public service pages, shareable results, public profiles, optional embeds, citations and user-controlled sharing.

evidence.reference: Owner direction, 2026-11-20: consider what creates public attention and adoption during development, not after.

risks: Do not promise virality or guaranteed growth.
Do not use fake urgency, fake counters or deceptive sharing incentives.
Privacy settings and moderation can limit public propagation by design.
acceptance_criteria: Each major service records its user value, repeat-use mechanism and distribution mechanism.
Public sharing is user-controlled and privacy-preserving.
Adoption performance is measured with real activation, retention, referral and sharing data.
entries.notes: Approved cross-cutting design requirement; the specific channels and mechanics remain service-dependent.

entries.title: Product Development Memory and Decision Continuity
entries.problem: Product strategy, accepted decisions, candidate capabilities, evidence and implementation rationale can become fragmented across conversations and repository subsystems.
entries.user_benefit: Future development agents and maintainers can recover durable product intent, decision reasons, dependencies and unresolved questions from the repository.
entries.distinctive_value: A concise structured memory layer with explicit authority boundaries, evidence provenance and deterministic anti-garbage/anti-loop validation.
entries.repeat_use: Every non-trivial product-development task reads and updates the relevant records.
entries.distribution_mechanism: Repository-grounded continuity for new conversations, SI providers and maintainers.

evidence.reference: Owner approval, 2026-11-20: create the Product Development Memory and verify its quality controls.

risks: Documentation can duplicate other authoritative systems if boundaries are not maintained.
An AI can still write a substantively incorrect but structurally valid record.
Overly complex schemas can create friction and discourage useful records.
acceptance_criteria: All key product capabilities have explicit approval states and rationale.
Accepted decisions preserve alternatives, consequences and approval provenance.
Strict validation rejects malformed, duplicated, dangling and cyclic records.
The memory links to existing sources instead of copying them.
entries.notes: Internal development capability; it is not a public user-facing service.
